identity.description: Vonage is a communications API provider offering SMS, Voice, Messages, Verify, Numbers, Account and related APIs for developers, with a developer portal at developer.vonage.com.
identity.identity_notes: developer.vonage.com describes Vonage's suite of communications APIs. The vonage.com homepage was not fetched. Vonage Business Communications (a separate UC product) and a telekom-hosted docs mirror also appear in search results and are not the target here.

auth.token_refresh: The client generates JWTs from the application ID and private key. No OAuth refresh flow was found.
auth.scopes_notes: Basic auth sends the API key and secret base64-encoded. JWT is built from an application ID and a private key (RS256). Per-API auth support is only partly established.

access.production_restrictions: Not established. Carrier or regulatory registration for SMS and voice numbers was not researched.

read_ops: Check account balance (per MCP tooling example)
List applications linked to API keys (per MCP tooling example)
api.limitations: The product list comes from the API index page. Endpoint-level detail, the API protocol (REST is likely but not quoted in any source), and the per-API auth matrix were not verified. The Messages API is labelled beta on the index page.

claims.value: Vonage provides a suite of APIs for communicating with customers over preferred channels
claims.quote: Vonage provides a suite of APIs that enable you to communicate with your customers using your preferred channels.

claims.value: Free credit is given when an account is first opened
claims.quote: We'll give you some free credit when you first open your account and you can top up when you run low.

claims.value: Creating an account yields an API key and secret
claims.quote: This will give you an API key and secret that you can use to access our APIs.

claims.value: Newer APIs use API key and secret, base64-encoded
claims.quote: A number of newer Vonage APIs require authentication to be done using an API key and secret sent Base64 encoded

claims.value: JWTs are generated from application ID and private key (RS256)
claims.quote: These JWTs are generated using the application ID and private key that is provided

claims.value: JWT is recommended for most use cases
claims.quote: For most use-cases we recommend JWT Authentication.

claims.value: Basic auth does not support webhooks
claims.quote: Messages supports both JWT and Basic authentication, however basic authentication does not support webhooks

claims.quote: Make and receive telephone calls to or from anywhere in the world.

open_questions: Which API protocol(s) are used. REST is likely, but no source quoted it.
Per-API auth matrix (which APIs accept Basic, JWT, or signature) is not fully visible from the fetched page.
Is the Tooling MCP server (@vonage/vonage-mcp-server-api-bindings) published from a Vonage-owned GitHub repo? The guessed repo URL returned 404.
Rate limits, sandbox availability, and US/regulatory registration (10DLC, number compliance) for SMS and voice were not researched.
Are there admin, partner, or sales gates for specific products such as Messages or Verify?

assessment.approach: Wrap/benchmark vendor's official MCP server; add managed auth
